description: This Java class defines a REST API resource for managing payment types in the Apache Fineract project. It includes endpoints for retrieving all payment types, retrieving a specific payment type, creating, updating, and deleting payment types, utilizing annotations for Swagger documentation, security checks, and request/response handling.

classes.name: PaymentTypeApiResource
classes.description: REST resource class handling payment type related API endpoints, including CRUD operations.

methods.name: getAllPaymentTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all payment types, optionally filtering to only those with a code.

methods.name: retrieveOnePaymentType
methods.description: Retrieves a specific payment type by its ID.

methods.name: createPaymentType
methods.description: Creates a new payment type using provided request data.

methods.name: updatePaymentType
methods.description: Updates an existing payment type identified by its ID.

methods.name: deleteCode
methods.description: Deletes a payment type by its ID.
